text:
marco-sdr: Heads up team 0min: Greenleaf Health wants a hosted demo key for an on-site POC next Wed. They need: single key for demo laptop (chat + embeddings), IP allowlist for 3 office IPs, short TTL, and billing tag 'poc/greenleaf'. Also asked for a simple rotation & revoke playbook for their security reviewer.

asya-eng: We can do ephemeral hosted keys scoped to chat+embeds. Security usually enforces 24h TTL for public-hosted credentials. I can pre-create a standby key and drop both into 1Password. Send IPs and the demo contact.

marco-sdr: IPs: 198.51.100.22, 198.51.100.23, 198.51.100.24. Demo contact: demo@greenleaf.example.com. They prefer 48h but will accept 24h if needed.

emily-sec: For the questionnaire: include proof of creation + revocation events and exported CSV from Console Activity. Note: hosted keys are managed by Redwood control plane (no per-tenant KMS). Flagged as an enterprise requirement if they insist on KMS wrapping.

asya-eng: Here's the API call I'll use (admin token redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"poc-greenleaf-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"rate_limit":8,"allowlist_ips":["198.51.100.22","198.51.100.23","198.51.100.24"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/greenleaf","contact":"demo@greenleaf.example.com"}}'

devops-bot: key created: hosted_key_poc_greenleaf_2024  created by asya-eng  expires in 24h  scopes: chat, embeddings  rate_limit:8 req/s

marco-sdr: Please confirm where the security team can download the audit CSV and a screenshot of the key metadata.

emily-sec: Console -> Activity -> API Keys export. We log create/rotate/revoke events, creator identity, IP allowlist, and metadata tags. I'll attach a redacted CSV to the deal folder after the demo.

asya-eng: Rotation/revocation playbook I recommend: 1) issue ephemeral key with 24h TTL, 2) store both primary and standby in 1Password, 3) if key compromise suspected run revoke endpoint, 4) post-demo revoke and export audit CSV. Revoke example:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_key_poc_greenleaf_2024/revoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'

marco-sdr: Customer Q: can the hosted key be KMS-wrapped so they never see plaintext in control plane?

emily-sec: Not for hosted keys. KMS-backed keys available only on Private deployment or Dedicated with enterprise keying options. Mark as blocker in questionnaire and offer a Private trial.

asya-eng: Done. I've uploaded the created key to the deal vault and set billing tag. Will revoke after the demo window.

devops-bot: key revoked: hosted_key_poc_greenleaf_2024  revoked by asya-eng  revocation_time: 1765560200

marco-sdr: Thanks all. I shared the audit CSV and the revoke screenshot with the customer and closed the prep loop. :thumbsup:
